plugin.note: Bats and Giant bats have low Defence and few Hitpoints, so any melee weapon clears them. Air spells exploit the elemental weakness for a Magic-training alternative. Giant bats are the most common variety and give more Slayer XP.

requirements: Combat level 5 is required to be assigned Bats.
No Slayer level or quest requirement for the base task.
Albino bats (Cabin Fever) and Death wings (Legends' Quest) also count but need quest progress.
mechanics: Bats attack with melee (stab) at 4 ticks; the Bat max hit is 1, the Giant bat max hit is 3.
Bats have an elemental weakness to air spells (35% on the Bat, 10% on the Giant bat).
Giant bats are aggressive to players of combat level 54 or lower except in Arceuus.
Bats drop only bat bones or nothing, so the task is done for Slayer XP and streak, not loot.

methods.label: Any melee weapon
methods.summary: Kill Giant bats (or regular Bats) with any melee weapon at a common bat spot.
steps: Travel to a bat spawn in Kandarin or Morytania.
Kill the Giant bats (32 HP) or Bats (8 HP); minimal food is needed.
Prefer Giant bats for more Slayer XP per kill.
notes: Giant bats are aggressive below combat level 54, so they walk to you.

methods.label: Air spells
methods.summary: Cast air spells to exploit the elemental weakness while training Magic.
requiredOrKeyItems: Air staff and runes, or a trident
steps: Bring an air staff (or trident) and attack the bats with air spells.
The air weakness makes Magic accurate against them.
notes: The regular Bat has the larger 35% air weakness.
